reviews.text: We stopped by with Joey just to buy probiotics, but on the way the dog got bloody diarrhea. And got quite sick. Hanna took us in, and did a thorough examination despite the fact that there were other waiting customers. You get very stressed in such a situation, and she reassured us very much (both owner and dog) very nice follow-up, and very relieved to have such a good offer in Oslo. We have been going there for a few years and are very satisfied, highly recommended.
Great veterinarian who managed to catch and examine my shy and terrified budgie (who was completely healthy).
Wonderful people who work there and take great care of your pet

We have used this clinic for our two Yorkshire Terriers and have been very happy. But now that I have a sick dog, it is impossible to get through on the phone. And no one calls back.
This is the 8th time I have called and no one has called back. In two days.
We will unfortunately have to find another vet if this continues.

Came in with a herring gull that couldn't stand on its legs. Got an appointment, even though this was a wild bird, and there was a thorough examination including X-rays. Very nice and knowledgeable veterinarian, who also made sure there was no chance of infection to domestic birds at the clinic. Highly recommended!
Nice and accommodating staff. Decent premises and plenty of parking.

Our bird had serious breathing problems. We first called here because they have a bird specialist, but were told to check elsewhere. When we called back, we tried for over 25 minutes without anyone answering. Finally had to show up with a terminally ill bird that clearly needed emergency care. Here we met a laid-back receptionist who apparently did "nothing", so it seems very strange that no one answered the phone. The bird specialist was busy with some dental work for a dog, and despite the fact that there were other vets present, we were turned away. Ironically, there was also a poster in the reception area stating that critically ill animals should be prioritized... This is a place that does not care about the well-being or health of the animals. When we finally found a specialist an hour and a half away, we were confirmed that it was completely irresponsible to turn away a bird in its condition. If you own a bird, go somewhere else. There was zero help or consideration here.
Thanks for the nice review, it's appreciated :)
A skilled veterinarian who loves animals. Can safely be recommended ☺️
Super and accommodating veterinarians, solid professional knowledge in a safe environment, and always good follow-up. Recommended for all animals and animal lovers.

I would like to share my experience so that both the clinic and hopefully other pet owners can learn or benefit from it. The story concerns an incident a few years ago when my cat, who was only three years old, started to behave differently. She became lethargic and defecated in places other than the litter box.

I took her to your clinic, where we were warmly welcomed. After going through her entire medical history, it was agreed that she would be thoroughly examined, including all the necessary biochemical tests. During the clinical examination, a heart murmur was detected, which needed to be evaluated further. I left the cat with you for a few hours to ensure that nothing was overlooked.

When I picked her up later that day, I was told that no serious illness had been detected. The extra murmur was considered normal, and both blood and urine tests were fine. It was concluded that the cat was probably a little depressed or anxious, and you suggested trying sedatives.

A week later, my cat died after a very traumatic episode in which she suddenly had severe breathing problems. The autopsy showed that she was severely anemic, had very low platelets, and several other abnormalities in her blood. These conditions had developed over time, but were not detected or properly investigated during what should have been a thorough examination at your clinic.

Reply to "owner":
I find it unfortunate that you are meeting my review with such a dismissive and suspicious tone. I wrote this feedback in good faith, so that both the clinic and other pet owners can learn from my experience.

For the record, I would like to clarify that I did in fact contact you after the cat's death and inform you of the autopsy results. It is therefore disappointing that you are suggesting that I have not been a customer of yours, or that I am deliberately withholding information. I had hoped for a more professional and thoughtful response, where you took note of the feedback instead of becoming defensive.

I stand by my experience and review.
